scope: Current bundled CIF source declarations plus historical removal receipt. On 2026-11-05 the He structure was replaced with COD 1000054; other CIF payloads and EOS evidence remain unchanged. No publication-wide grant is inferred. A subsequent 2026-11-05 source replacement adds CC0 COD 9009217 for two post-perovskite structural records without changing numerical model values. Six additional unchanged COD source CIFs support independently calculated reference patterns; proxy substitutions, reference-cell overrides and numerical-parameter-only inputs are separately documented.

cod_policy.scope: COD states that its data and database are dedicated to the public domain under CC0; original research articles are separate.

cif_comparison_method: Remove only complete comment lines beginning #$Date: or #$URL:, preserving every other byte and line ending. Exact SHA-256 values are also retained for each original/served file.

files.qualification: Fresh primary COD and two mirror CIFs inspected. Only SVN Date/URL comments differ; all other bytes match. Ab initio coordinates using the observed 121 GPa, 300 K cell, not experimentally refined positions. Legacy attribution header retained verbatim. Original Science article was not freshly re-audited.

files.source_license: CC0-1.0, as declared by COD for its data/database
files.qualification: Fe3P-type topology proxy from meteoritic (Fe,Ni)3P COD 9007338: replace all Ni by Fe and P by S. This is not a refined Fe3S structure or a prediction of experimental intensities. The existing Fe3S reference cell is retained. Original CIF bytes and headers retained; publication itself not licensed by COD.

files.source_license: CC0-1.0, as declared by COD for its data/database
files.qualification: COD 1566661 is the cited Besson deuterated ice VIII structure at 2.8 GPa / 296 K. Reference cell retained. These are X-ray electron-scattering intensities, not neutron intensities; D has the H form factor. Original CIF bytes and headers retained; publication itself not licensed by COD.

files.source_license: CC0-1.0, as declared by COD for its data/database
files.qualification: COD 9010029 Angel et al. (1989), including reported Mg/Si occupational disorder. Calculate in the CIF native origin using its explicit symmetry operations. Existing EOSMAT sites use an equivalent x+1/2 origin. Reference cell retained. Original CIF bytes and headers retained; publication itself not licensed by COD.

files.source_license: CC0-1.0, as declared by COD for its data/database
files.qualification: COD 9006822 Kagi et al. (2000) supplies both heavy atoms and H sites, with the heavy-atom model inherited from Horiuchi et al. Reference cell remains the existing Horiuchi cell (7.8603,7.8603,9.573 A), rather than the slightly smaller CIF cell. Rounded special thirds are snapped within 5e-6 before symmetry expansion. No measured peak strengths are represented. Original CIF bytes and headers retained; publication itself not licensed by COD.

files.source_license: CC0-1.0, as declared by COD for its data/database
files.qualification: Pure MgSiO3 COD 9005757 (Yagi et al. 1978) geometry used as an explicit topology proxy for nominal Mg0.88Fe0.12SiO3. Replace the Mg site by 0.88 Mg + 0.12 Fe statistically; retain the existing EOS reference cell. No Fe-bearing specimen refinement or site preference determination is claimed. Original CIF bytes and headers retained; publication itself not licensed by COD.

files.source_license: CC0-1.0, as declared by COD for its data/database
files.qualification: COD 9001848 Yang, Prewitt and Frost (1997), including reported occupancies, Mg1.11Si1.89H2.22O6 per cell. Retain existing reference cell. Rounded special thirds are snapped within 5e-6. No Fe site occupancy is invented: the EOS sample contains about 3.7 wt% Fe, so this is a structural surrogate. Original CIF bytes and headers retained; publication itself not licensed by COD.

limits: COD grants are recorded as source declarations, not independent authentication of every underlying contributor right.
HTTP failures at the thesis repository are access limitations, not licensing evidence. Unverified source terms remain unspecified.

removed_files.contributor_scope: CC0-1.0 only for contributor-held transcription/normalization/metadata rights
removed_files.source_license: No separately verified thesis/table reuse grant established
removed_files.source_location: He Xuejing (2023), Table 4.3, printed pp. 81-82; fluorine-free hydrogenated sample
removed_files.qualification: The indexed institutional record displays the thesis with an unpopulated license column; that incomplete observation is not evidence that no grant exists. Live record/API/file-detail requests returned HTTP 503 (browser record request returned 429), so no fresh source license could be verified. Public availability and a contributor dedication do not establish original thesis rights. This is not a finding that factual numerical values are copyrighted or non-free.
removed_files.required_action: Obtain a dataset-specific grant from the relevant rights holder, or a documented numerical-facts/rights assessment accepted by the downstream reviewer.
removed_files.preservation: Original evidence retained privately; source grant remains unresolved.

brucite_record.observations: Brucite, H2 Mg O2; space group 164, Z=1, complete sites, no disorder reported, R=0.08. Entry footer explicitly declares COD data/database CC0.
